We conduct extensive experiments on seven datasets for three generation tasks on three distinct language model architectures, including a recent Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of M-RAG across diverse RAG baselines. In comparison to the best baseline approach, M-RAG exhibits improvements of 11%, 8%, and 12% for text summarization, machine translation, and dialogue generation tasks, respectively.
